title: Is This Mamdani’s 2029 Opponent? If So, LOL
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait.'**

**Justin Baragona** here, bringing you the latest media dispatches from the
right-wing industrial outrage complex and Bari World. In tonight's edition,
does Zohran Mamdani need to take the threat of "Barstool conservatism"
seriously ahead of his next mayoral election? Also, Anderson Cooper just can't
seem to get away from Bari Weiss, and NPR really steps in it over a botched
Supreme Court story.

Amid the [current political freakout](https://slate.com/news-and-

left-edge-american-politics) and [establishment
Democrats](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/29/centrist-democrats-
democratic-socialists-backlash)) over **Zohran Mamdani 's** [role as
kingmaker](https://zeteo.com/p/zohran-mamdani-kingmaker-political-capital) as
[anti-war progressives](https://zeteo.com/p/claire-valdez-darializa-avila-
chevalier-brad-lander) and [democratic socialists](https://zeteo.com/p/aipac-
loses-as-the-left-wins-big) rack up [primary
victories](https://zeteo.com/p/aipac-defeated-again-this-time-in), the New
York City mayor suddenly found himself a potential new challenger for 2029.
